children.value: > Fact From Story During the last violent outbreak between Hamas and Israel in 2021, a report commissioned by Meta and conducted by a third party concluded that the company’s actions had an “adverse human rights impact” on Palestinian users’ right to freedom of expression and political participation.

> > Fact From Story Meta struggles to navigate the cultural and linguistic nuances of Arabic, a language with over 25 dialects, and has been criticized for neglecting to adequately diversify its language resources.
> > > Fact From Story The company’s black-and-white policies often preclude it from effectively moderating any nuanced topic, like content that discusses violence without condoning it.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge Nuance is important for understanding complicated topics.
> > Commonsense Knowledge Moderation is more difficult when the language used is not well understood by the moderators.
